sections.heading: MINOR IN CATHOLIC STUDIES
lines: Completion of first-year requirements. Religious Studies 1027E is recommended.

0.5 course from: Religious Studies 2201F/G, Religious Studies 2202F/G, Religious Studies 2210F/G, Religious Studies 2211F/G, Religious Studies 2212F/G, Religious Studies 2213F/G, Religious Studies 2214F/G, Religious Studies 2215F/G, Religious Studies 2255F/G, the former Religious Studies 2101A/B and the former Religious Studies 2102A/B.
0.5 course from: Religious Studies 2205F/G, Religious Studies 2271F/G, Religious Studies 2272F/G, Religious Studies 2294F/G.

3.0 additional courses from the following, if not taken previously: Religious Studies 2134A/B, Religious Studies 2201F/G, Religious Studies 2202F/G, Religious Studies 2205F/G, Religious Studies 2207E, Religious Studies 2210F/G, Religious Studies 2211F/G, Religious Studies 2212F/G, Religious Studies 2213F/G, Religious Studies 2214F/G, Religious Studies 2215F/G, Religious Studies 2218F/G, Religious Studies 2223E, Religious Studies 2234F/G, Religious Studies 2238F/G, Religious Studies 2239F/G, Religious Studies 2294F/G, Religious Studies 2250E, Religious Studies 2271F/G, Religious Studies 2272F/G and the former Religious Studies 2101A/B, the former Religious Studies 2102A/B, the former Religious Studies 2132 and the former Religious Studies 2140, the former Religious Studies 2235F/G.
Note: Students should be aware of the following course sequencing issues with respect to this module:
1) Religious Studies 2271F/G and Religious Studies 2272F/G cannot normally be taken until at least third year as they require prerequisites of Religious Studies 2201F/G and Religious Studies 2202F/G.
2) The Department of Philosophy and Religious Studies offers certain courses in alternate years; students are responsible for checking the Departmental Website for course rotation information.
